hero.supporting_line: Plan Your Conference with Clear Application Responsibilities
hero.description: SYNC supports your conference application to the Saudi Conventions and Exhibitions General Authority (SCEGA), from classification review and document preparation to submission coordination and follow-up. For conferences in Riyadh, Jeddah and across Saudi Arabia, we help connect the application information to your programme, venue and organizing team. SCEGA reviews the application and makes the licensing decision.

clients_heading: Businesses We Have Supported Across Saudi Arabia

classification.intro: A SCEGA conference licence is the authority's approval for the applicable conference category. The application route depends on the programme, organizing entity, venue and accompanying activities. A one-day format or an overseas speaker does not, by itself, settle that classification.

scope_heading: What Our SCEGA Conference Permit Service Covers
scope_intro: We agree the application tasks with your team before work begins. You know what SYNC coordinates, which information you provide and which decisions remain with the authority.

scope.title: Classification & Eligibility Review
scope.answer: SYNC reviews the conference format, organizing entity and accompanying activities to identify the applicable route and outstanding eligibility questions. Your team provides the event brief and accurate entity and applicant information; the authority confirms eligibility and licensing requirements.

scope.title: Application File Preparation
scope.answer: We help organize the programme, speaker information, venue details and supporting documents, and check the file for gaps and inconsistencies. Your team supplies the requested records, authorizations and final confirmation that the information is accurate.

scope.title: Submission Coordination
scope.answer: We coordinate the agreed submission tasks, attachments and application information through the appropriate process. Your team provides the necessary authorization and approvals for us to support the application; SCEGA receives and assesses it.

scope.title: Application Follow-Up & Corrections
scope.answer: We track requests for clarification and help coordinate corrected information or additional documents during review. Your team responds to outstanding questions and approves material changes before they are submitted.

scope.title: Changes & Cancellation Support
scope.answer: If the dates, venue, programme or event scope change, we help review the relevant amendment or cancellation steps. Tell us as soon as plans change so any authority requirements, revised documents or applicable charges can be checked.

fees.title: Government Fees
fees.description: Local conferences, seminars and forums: SAR 5,000. International conferences, seminars and forums: SAR 10,000.

fees.title: SYNC Professional Fees
fees.description: Quoted separately for the agreed application support and any additional event services. Government charges are not SYNC's professional fees.

fees.title: Published Service Period
fees.description: 5 working days for the listed conference service. Allow separate time to prepare the file and respond to additional review requests.

fees_note: Government fees and the published service period are subject to the applicable category and current authority conditions. The service period is not a promise of approval within five days of your first enquiry.

faqs.question: Does a one-day corporate conference need a SCEGA permit?
faqs.answer: A one-day duration does not, by itself, determine the licensing route. We review the programme, organizing entity, venue, participants and accompanying activities to identify the relevant conference requirements.

faqs.question: Can our company apply directly, or do we need an eligible conference organizer?
faqs.answer: That depends on the service's eligibility conditions, the organizing entity and the applicant's account and authorization. SYNC reviews the proposed arrangements with you; application support does not replace any requirement for an eligible organizer or authorized applicant.

faqs.question: What information should we send SYNC to start?
faqs.answer: Send your organizing entity, conference purpose, draft programme, speakers, proposed venue, dates and expected attendance, plus any sponsor booths or accompanying activities. We review the brief, identify outstanding information and agree the support scope before preparing the file.

faqs.question: What is the difference between local and international conference licensing?
faqs.answer: The applicable classification and government fee depend on the authority's criteria and the conference circumstances. Do not assume that one overseas speaker makes the event international; we review the full format and proposed participation before confirming the application route.

faqs.question: How much does a conference permit cost, and how long does the service take?
faqs.answer: The listed government fees are SAR 5,000 for local and SAR 10,000 for international conferences, seminars and forums; SYNC's professional fees are separate. The published conference service period is five working days, with additional time needed for file preparation or further review; confirm the current category and conditions before payment.

faqs.question: Can our conference include sponsor booths or an exhibition area?
faqs.answer: Include the booths and exhibition area in the initial brief. We review whether the activities fit the conference scope or require additional approvals; an accompanying display should not automatically be treated as the same application as an independent trade exhibition.

faqs.question: Can a foreign company arrange a conference in Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: The available arrangements depend on the company's status, the selected service and the eligibility and representation requirements. We review the proposed organizer, applicant and authorizations so the relevant questions are resolved before submission.

faqs.question: Can we promote the conference before the licence is issued?
faqs.answer: Check the applicable SCEGA conditions before announcing, selling access to or promoting your conference. Submitting an application is not permission to proceed with activities that require a licence or promotional approval; we help identify the conditions relevant to your plan.

faqs.question: Can SYNC help with overseas speakers, hotel bookings and visa paperwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can agree a separate guest-support scope covering accommodation coordination and visa application information or supporting documents. The event licence and each traveller's visa or entry permission are separate processes, and their decisions remain with the relevant authorities.

faqs.question: What happens if our application is returned or our conference details change?
faqs.answer: A request to complete or correct an application is different from changing a submitted or licensed event. We review the authority's feedback or your revised dates, venue and programme, then help coordinate the appropriate response, amendment or cancellation steps.
